book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: على الباخرة، فيكس دور على باسبارتو.
sentences.en: On the steamer, Fix looked for Passepartout.

sentences.ar: لأنه الخادم بيحكي أكتر من السيد.
sentences.en: Because a servant talks more than a master.
And found him on deck, watching the Red Sea.

sentences.ar: قال فيكس: إنت الشاب من السويس!
sentences.en: Fix said: you are the young man from Suez!

sentences.ar: قال باسبارتو: وإنت الرجل اللي دلني عالقنصلية!
sentences.en: Passepartout said: and you are the man who showed me the consulate!
And they became friends.

sentences.ar: وفيكس عزمه على كاس، وبعدين كاس تاني.
sentences.en: And Fix treated him to a glass, and then another.
Fix said: your master is a strange man.
Passepartout said: very strange.

sentences.ar: قال فيكس: ما بيطلع من كابينته.
sentences.en: Fix said: he does not leave his cabin.
Passepartout said: never.
He has not seen the sea.
Fix said: and he travels fast.
Passepartout said: a wager!
Round the world in eighty days!
And Fix laughed inside.
And said: a wager.
Of course.
An excellent excuse.
Fix said: and is he rich?
Passepartout said: very rich.

sentences.ar: وحامل معه رزمة أوراق مصاري، جديدة.
sentences.en: And carrying a bundle of banknotes, new ones.
And hands them out without counting.

sentences.ar: أعطى قبطان الباخرة مكافأة كبيرة عشان يمشي أسرع.
sentences.en: He gave the captain a big reward to go faster.
And Fix said to himself: new notes.
From the bank.
And asked: and how long have you been with him?
Passepartout said: since the day we left.
The first day!
And Fix was pleased: a new servant.
He knows nothing of his past.
So the past is dark.
And Passepartout talked and talked, and Fix listened.

sentences.ar: عن الغاز اللي نسيه مشعول، وعن الجوارب، وعن الساعات.
sentences.en: About the gas he had left burning, and the socks, and the clocks.
And Fix became certain.
And at the same time, he thought about the warrant.

sentences.ar: إذا ما وصلت لبومباي، فوغ بيكمل للهند، وهناك ما إله سلطة.
sentences.en: If it did not reach Bombay, Fogg would go on into India, and there he had no authority.
Fix said: I must delay him.
By any means.

sentences.ar: وباسبارتو قال: يا سيد فيكس، إنت رجل طيب.
sentences.en: And Passepartout said: Mr. Fix, you are a good man.
And Fix said: and so are you.
